Strong scripting and automation skills for artist-facing tools and content workflows, with the ability to work productively in Python, Blueprint, or comparable scripting environments. Hands-on pipeline development experience, including procedural workflows, asset generation, and integration with real-time content pipelines. Proven experience designing or maintaining reusable, modular, and parameterized VFX systems, libraries, or production workflows. Strong understanding of real-time VFX readability, profiling, optimization, and performance budgeting, with the ability to balance visual quality and runtime constraints. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Art, Design, and Engineering, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and support artists through tool iteration and problem-solving. Desired Qualifications: Experience supporting large-scale multiplayer or live-service content pipelines, where consistency, scalability, and maintainability are central production concerns. Experience developing procedural content workflows or reusable generation systems in Houdini, Unreal, or related tools. Experience with streaming, resource, memory, or workload optimization for content-rich real-time experiences. Familiarity with shader or engine-level development, including HLSL, C++, or comparable low-level graphics and runtime technologies. A portfolio or reel that demonstrates technical breakdowns, reusable systems, artist-facing tools, pipeline improvements, and the impact of your work on content production. offers.title: Lead VFX Artist
offers.description: About Gameloft Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games. There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures. With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are. If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game! WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON Main challenge We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals. You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology. What it means on a daily basis VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope. Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews. Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners. VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements. Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development. What success will look like After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio. After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio. Who you would be working with You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process. Your recruitment journey HR Screen Call Test Second Interview Final Interview Where this role can take you This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities. WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio. Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine. Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine. Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience. Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max. Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids. Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards. Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback. Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology. Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial. Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus. Some experience with animation would also be a plus. Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment. WHO YOU ARE You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders. You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output. You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment. You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself. Why Join the World of Gameloft? Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing! Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers! Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures! Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace! Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work! Benefits Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits. 25 vacation days per year. Private medical health insurance. Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card. Flexible work-from-home hybrid model. Free language courses. Your birthday off! 1 month of remote work. Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package. Career development opportunities. Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona. ...and Thursday after-work beers! We can’t wait to find our next great talent! Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us! Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months. Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

We are looking for someone who can take a question like "can we make it look like this?" and turn the visual idea into a solution that is performant, reusable, artist-friendly, and scalable across a large game. You will work closely with VFX Artists and Engineers on shaders, particles, GPU-driven effects, runtime architecture, tooling, mobile optimization, and gameplay integration. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical ownership, where you will be expected to prototype solutions, make architectural decisions, and take systems through to production. Key Responsibilities Develop scalable runtime systems for high-frequency gameplay effects. Build solutions for pooling, shared emitters, batching, prioritization, and effect budgets. Develop shaders using HLSL , Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar tools. Work with particle systems, mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, procedural effects, and GPU-driven techniques. Build artist-facing Unity tools, validators, custom inspectors, asset processors, and batch workflows. Optimize effects for mobile GPUs, memory, overdraw, shader complexity, and runtime performance. Collaborate with VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers. Prototype new technical approaches and take successful solutions through to production. Establish reusable templates, documentation, and technical standards for the VFX team. Requirements Strong HLSL shader programming experience. Fluency with node-based tools such as Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar. Strong understanding of real-time rendering including blending, transparency, sorting, depth, instancing, and scriptable or custom render pipelines. Experience shipping particle-based effects in Unity using Shuriken or equivalent systems. Experience with mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, and shader-driven effects. Experience designing scalable effect runtimes for high-frequency effects, including pooling, batching, prioritization, or budget management. Strong C# gameplay or engine programming experience. Experience with ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, or equivalent performance-focused architecture is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of mobile GPU optimization including overdraw, half precision, texture budgets, memory, and shader variants. Unity editor tooling experience including custom inspectors, drawers, asset processors, or batch tools. Understanding of Metal, Vulkan, and GLES , including platform-specific graphics limitations and shader or PSO warmup. Strong communication skills across both artistic and engineering disciplines. Fluent English. Nice to Have Strong Unity DOTS/Entities experience. Experience with ECS-based rendering or instanced material properties. Compute shaders and GPU-driven effects. Vertex animation techniques. SDFs, procedural noise, and procedural rendering. Experience with procedural or voxel geometry, dynamic meshes, hull generation, or custom lighting systems. Networked gameplay effects including predicted versus confirmed events. Experience with multiplayer or large-scale gameplay systems. Strong artistic eye and ability to participate in VFX look development. Experience building effects for mobile or other performance-constrained platforms. offers.title: Sr. VFX Artist
offers.description: Lakshya, a Keywords Studios company, in India is headquartered in Gurgaon and has a team of over 700 employees spread across studio facilities in Gurgaon, Pune and Seattle, and sales offices in San Diego and Tokyo. Setup in 2004, Lakshya has, over the last 20 years, created a reputation in the game development industry for being a highly talented and dependable game art studio. During this time, Lakshya has created art for over a hundred game titles, including hugely successful global hits such as Bloodborne, Dark Souls II, Just Cause 3, WWE 2K16, Uncharted 2, Farmville and Cityville. Lakshya’s senior team, which comprises of top-notch International and Indian talent, has a huge amount of experience of creating art for different game platforms and genres. Lakshya blends artistic creativity with strong process orientation in order to deliver best in class services. Lakshya works closely with NASSCOM to help in the growth of the game development eco-system in India. For more info, please refer to https://lakshyadigital.com/ About the Role: We are seeking a Senior VFX Artist to help lead the creation of high-impact real-time effects. In this role, you will create and implement VFX that bring Legends, weapons, and seasonal moments to life — reporting to the Lead VFX Artist and collaborating closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to raise the visual quality bar across the game. We are looking for someone with a passion for visceral, intense combat and a deep understanding of how VFX can drive player intensity, readability, and emotional impact in a fight. 5+ years of professional experience as a real-time VFX artist in the games or film industry. Strong portfolio of shipped in-game real-time VFX work; portfolio examples that showcase bombastic, gritty combat and VFX-driven player intensity are a strong plus. Proficiency with relevant DCC tools such as Maya, Houdini, Photoshop, or Substance Designer, and experience implementing your own work within a game engine or proprietary toolset. Experience mentoring, reviewing work, or helping guide other artists, with strong communication and collaboration skills across disciplines. Passion for making and playing games. Experience creating VFX for visceral, intense combat games is a plus. Experience with first-person games, sci-fi art direction, or live-service seasonal content is a plus. Shipped AAA game credit is a plus. Responsibilities: Create and implement high-quality real-time VFX for abilities, weapons, seasonal content, and gameplay moments — with a focus on delivering effects that feel visceral, impactful, and true to the intensity of combat. Help define and maintain the visual quality bar for VFX across seasonal updates, weapon releases, character abilities, and gameplay moments. VFX problem-solving for complex content, including visual polish, performance constraints, and technical issues across the content pipeline. Collaborate closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to develop effects that support gameplay, improve clarity, and strengthen the visual identity of Apex Legends. Helping raise the quality and consistency of the team’s work. Contribute to visual direction and help evolve real-time VFX language, supporting production planning to ensure work is scoped and delivered effectively. We offer the opportunity to work on some of the best-known game titles in the world. We offer competitive salaries and annual performance-based bonuses. We offer generous paid time off. You get 26 Annual leaves and additional paid time off at the year-end (from 25th December to 1st January). We cover Term Insurance and Personal accidental insurance for you. Benefit from our free Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental and emotional wellbeing. You can also avail our Special Education Assistance Scheme to further develop your career. … And a lot more! offers.description: Job Title: Activision 2027 Summer Internships - VFX Requisition ID: R028074 Job Description: Activision is looking for talented and innovative students to join our teams for summer 2027. All interns will receive a meaningful project and an unparalleled experience. We’ll provide the tools and resources you need to learn. The challenging and creative work you do throughout your internship will directly impact the team you are contributing to. All internships will be conducted in-person. Hosting managers will determine when and how often interns work in the office. All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement). Additionally, all interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs. Program Requirements Currently enrolled in a certificate, associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree program and graduating May 2027 - June 2028 Available to participate in a 12-week internship starting in mid-May or mid-June Currently residing in the US or open to relocating oneself to the US Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner Works well with others and contributes to team tasks Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively A passion for significantly impacting game development Applicants must apply with a resume and portfolio/reel to be considered Internship Opportunities VFX Intern: Join our world-class team bringing the iconic visuals of Call of Duty to life. As a VFX Intern, you’ll contribute to real-time effects that heighten gameplay—from explosive battlefield moments to immersive environmental details. You’ll collaborate with experienced artists and engineers to design dynamic, cinematic, and optimized visual effects using tools and in-game FX systems. This internship offers hands-on experience with AAA production pipelines, scripting multi-state FX objects, and balancing artistry with performance across next-gen platforms. You’ll gain a deep understanding of how visual effects shape player immersion and define the Call of Duty experience. Requirements: Experience creating real-time VFX simulations using Maya, 3ds Max, or in-game FX editors. Familiarity with Unreal, Unity, or proprietary game engines. Strong understanding of particle systems, shaders, dynamics, and 3D fundamentals. Experience with Houdini or Photoshop are a plus. A portfolio/reel that showcases real-time, photoreal visual effects is required Hosting Locations : High Moon Studios (Carlsbad, CA) & Treyarch (Playa Vista, CA) Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com . General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics. Rewards We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!  Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including: Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance; 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching; Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave; Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others; If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance. Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company.  You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/ . In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $20.00 - $50.00 Hourly. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed.   While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

offers.title: Senior VFX Artist - New Mobile Game
offers.description:
We are looking for a Senior VFX Artist to join our in-house art team working on a new mobile game . Bring your passion for gaming, VFX, and Tech Art. Learn continuously by interacting with our experienced team of Artists and Game Development specialists. We are enthusiastic about what we do, and we have fun doing it! Your mission Create high-quality real-time VFX for a 3D mobile game, including combat effects, abilities, impacts, environmental effects, transitions, UI effects, and reward moments. Build and improve art pipelines, tools, exporters, validation systems, and automation workflows. Develop , optimize, and maintain shaders and materials suitable for mobile performance constraints. Collaborate with engineers and artists on VFX pipelines, tools, performance profiling, and implementation workflows. Your skill set Expertise. You can showcase your professional experience (4+ years) based on an impressive portfolio. Knowledge . You have a solid understanding of graphics math and a willingness to keep learning and improving in this area. Coding . You are proficient in coding with C#, Python, HLSL, and CG Shader language or similar languages. 3D. You are experienced in modeling, skinning, and animation. Tools. You are skilled in using Houdini, Blender Geometry Nodes, or other comparable software. AI. You are willing to embrace new technologies and keen on AI-assisted production. Tech. You are proficient in using Unity3D. You understand technical constraints and are able to integrate your assets into the engine yourself. Team play. You are a proactive communicator, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are confidently interacting with an international/intercultural team of experts. Qualification. You have completed a university degree or comparable training in the field of graphics. English as company language. You feel comfortable in using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily. Your power-ups Career opportunities. Level up with excellent training and development opportunities, such as online trainings, InnoVersity and conferences. Outstanding benefits. Get 28 vacation days, a sabbatical, mobile device, contribution to your public transport ticket, and more. Flexible working hours. We offer trust-based working hours as well as active breaks - play table tennis with your team, work out in our gym or go to our rooftop terrace to get some fresh air. Hybrid Working Model. We offer our colleagues the flexibility to choose between working from home and our modern offices in central Hamburg. With regular times planned together at the office during our Office Days , we keep up our unique InnoGames spirit! Compensation & Fair Play . We have career models as well as market-competitive salary grids in place that ensure that we treat our employees fairly. For this position the regular level salary starts at € 50,000 and the senior level salary starts at € 65,000. The salary ranges for other seniority levels differ. Your seniority level (junior, regular, senior) will be evaluated during the interview process. Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Creative & Product Management . Team events. Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers. Relocation assistance. If you are interested in relocating to Hamburg, we will support you regarding all the needed resources.

InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world. InnoGames is best known for Forge of Empires, Elvenar and Tribal Wars, but the company is continually expanding its now 10-game portfolio across platforms and genres. Most recently, InnoGames launched Heroes of History, a novel mix of city builder and hero collection RPG.
 
Excited to start your journey with InnoGames and join our team as a VFX Artist ? We look forward to receiving your application as well as your salary expectations and earliest possible start date through our online application form. Anika Michel would be happy to answer any questions you may have.

Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. offers.description: Who is SkyBox Labs? Recognized as one of BC's Top Employers (2025) , SkyBox Labs is a game development studio that works on some of the world’s most iconic games. The studio is currently working on projects in the Minecraft universe, supporting the dev team at Bungie on Destiny 2, supporting development of Fallout 76, in addition to work on unannounced IP. PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. Interested? Let’s talk about what we’re hiring for: SkyBox Labs is looking for a graphics-focused Senior Technical Artist to join our team on an ambitious AAA co-development project set within a highly anticipated universe. Working closely with our partner studio, you’ll help develop shaders and materials, optimize rendering performance, and build tools and workflows in Unreal Engine 5. You’ll use your expertise in real-time rendering and GPU profiling to achieve high visual quality while meeting performance targets. We’re looking for an experienced, proactive technical artist who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working independently, and collaborating across art and engineering teams to find practical solutions. This is a hybrid role based at our Burnaby, BC studio, with three days per week in the office. A snapshot of your role: Shaders & Materials: Develop and optimize master materials, custom shaders, and PBR material libraries to support visual quality and performance. Rendering Performance: Profile GPU performance, identify rendering bottlenecks, and work with art and engineering teams to improve performance. Asset Optimization: Identify and resolve performance issues related to shaders, overdraw, textures, meshes, collision, and UVs. Renderer Debugging & Profiling: Utilize GPU profiling tools like Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, or PIX to analyze and optimize render passes, overdraw, and overall performance. Tools & Automation: Build tools and scripts using Python and Unreal Engine editor utilities to automate technical workflows and support asset validation. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with rendering engineers, technical directors, and artists to establish material standards, share best practices, and resolve technical challenges. Problem-Solving & Ownership: Take ownership of open-ended technical challenges, communicate proactively, and deliver effective solutions that balance visual quality and performance. Sound like you? This is what we're looking for: 7+ years of professional game development experience in technical art, with a focus on real-time graphics, materials, shaders, and rendering performance, including at least one shipped AAA title. Unreal Engine & PBR Expertise: Strong knowledge of UE5’s next-gen rendering pipeline including Lumen, Megalights, Grooms, Substrate, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, ISMs, and GPU particle systems. Shader Development: Experience creating, debugging, and optimizing custom shaders and complex material networks, with a solid understanding of real-time rendering. Performance Profiling: Hands-on experience using tools such as Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, PIX, or GPU vendor profilers to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python and experience building editor tools or scripts to automate workflows and validate asset performance. Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with artists and engineers, explain technical concepts, and help teams resolve challenges. Independent Problem-Solving: A self-motivated approach to tackling open-ended challenges, exploring solutions, and driving work forward with minimal direction. Nice-to-haves: DCC Pipeline Experience: Experience building or improving workflows between Unreal Engine and tools such as Autodesk Maya and Substance Painter/Designer. Console Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing performance for current-generation consoles, including PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. And here is why we think you'll love working at SkyBox: Annual bonus and up to 3% RRSP matching available Comprehensive health benefits, along with a supportive Maternity and Parental Leave policy Flexible hybrid working arrangements: leverage our beautiful studio spaces as needed and have the ability to work from home on certain projects Take care of your mental health with our Employee Assistance Program, 3 weeks of vacation leave, and our free gym at our Burnaby Studio We relentlessly support your growth and development! Level up your C++ skills at SkyBox University, explore other disciplines through our Guild Program, and expand your game dev knowledge with Lunch & Learns. You’ll join a culture of empowerment, collaboration, and personal growth. Social events! Have fun with the team at trivia nights, karaoke nights, movie nights, and various group activities. Avalanche Studios is looking for a talented Senior Technical Artist to join a top-tier, experienced team and help craft cutting-edge AAA open-world games. As a Senior Technical Artist at Avalanche, you will play a critical role in pushing our proprietary technology to its limits. We are looking for an industry veteran who thrives on autonomy and can focus on performance, visual fidelity, and pipeline efficiency. Once you are familiar with our internal engine and tools, you will identify bottlenecks, optimize game content, and support artist workflows through tooling and scripting. If you love solving complex technical challenges, profiling and optimizing, and redefining what is visually possible, this is the playground for you. What you'll do Take ownership of the game’s overall performance area, driving performance analysis and optimization across the project.
Tune visual quality and performance to find the right balance for the target platform.
Define, establish, and communicate performance budgets across relevant areas of the game.
Develop and/or request tools to support performance tracking, profiling, and analysis.
Work with telemetry data to identify performance trends, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.

Collaborate closely with Rendering and Systems teams to achieve the best possible balance between performance and visual quality on the platform. Who you are Several years of professional experience as a Technical Artist within the games industry.
Proven experience identifying bottlenecks, debugging, profiling, and optimizing game content for CPU, GPU, and memory.
Deep understanding of game engine pipelines and graphics/rendering principles.
Strong in scripting with Python and comfortable reading and navigating C++ codebases.
Familiar with HLSL (or a similar shading language) and have an interest in shader development. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement. At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

offers.title: Senior Technical Artist, Project R.I.S.E
offers.description: Great-looking games don't happen because someone drew something beautiful. They happen because someone figured out how to get that beautiful thing running at a stable framerate, on a phone, in a build the whole team can iterate on twenty times a day. That someone is you. We're looking for a Technical Artist to own the space between art and engineering on one of our new projects in the Shanghai studio. You'll be the person artists come to when the thing in Substance doesn't look like the thing in the engine, and the person programmers come to when the frame budget is blown and nobody's sure whose fault it is. You'll shape the visual identity of the game as much as any artist does — just through shaders, tooling, and pipelines rather than pixels. This is a small team with a lot of ownership. Nobody will hand you a spec. If that sounds like your kind of problem, we'd love to hear from you！ What You'll Be Doing Own the shader and material library. Author the shaders that give the game its look, design a master-material architecture artists can actually work with, and keep permutation counts and shader complexity from quietly eating the frame Build the tools artists live in. DCC scripts, engine editor extensions, one-click export, automated asset validation — every hour you save someone in Maya or the material editor goes back into the game, so treat tooling as a first-class deliverable, not a side project Raise the visual bar alongside the art team. Sit in look-dev with the art director, build the lighting and post-process templates that make the style reproducible, and close the gap between the concept on the wall and the thing running on device Keep art content within budget. Profile real builds on real phones, work out why the device is getting hot, and design the LOD and quality-tier systems that let the game scale from flagship to low-end without losing its identity Prototype the risky visual ideas. Before anyone commits to them, and be honest about which ones won't survive contact with the frame budget Be the interface to the engine team. Translate what artists want into renderer features programmers can scope, and translate what the renderer does into constraints artists can work with Set and hold the standards. Define how art content should be built, document it, onboard people onto the pipeline, and be the person who notices when things start slipping What You Have 8+ years in games, a meaningful chunk of it on the technical side of art Real shader authoring skill — HLSL, Unreal's material graph, or both — and enough scripting (Python, Blueprint, or C++) to build your own tools rather than request them A working mental model of how a frame gets rendered, and of where Unreal's content pipeline hides its costs Fluency across the DCC stack (Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, or your equivalents) and strong opinions about how they should connect to the engine The instinct to profile before optimizing, and the patience to chase a regression to its actual cause Comfort being the translation layer between two disciplines that don't always speak the same language — and the diplomacy that takes A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge Being a great teammate — we believe making games is a team sport Would Be Nice if You Also Have At least one shipped mobile title, and the scars to prove it — thermal throttling, bandwidth ceilings, memory budgets, the whole set A history of extending the Unreal editor when the existing workflow wasn't good enough Hands-on experience with AI agents and AI-assisted workflows, especially pointed at content or tooling problems Experience across the full arc of a project, from grey-box prototype to live service, and a sense of what matters at each stage Where You'll Be This role is based in our Shanghai office. If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Shanghai,China. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family! ––– That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. ––– About Supercell Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, and Squad Busters . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever. So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects. The Shanghai studio As Supercell’s first international game development studio, the Shanghai studio is one of the most exciting things happening in Supercell and a unique opportunity to join at a relatively early stage to help shape our path. Our vision is to be a world-class international studio, making new global hit games while leveraging the unique advantages of the game development scene in China and broader Asia. Hey, you Might Love It Here! Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way. You Are Not Your Job Title ™ Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here. Benefits and Compensation Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource. Relocation? Yes! No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind! Not sure if you should apply? Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process. Wishing you all the best, The Supercell Recruitment team P.S. Here's a video about what we do. (Best enjoyed with salmiakki and rye bread)

offers.title: Unity Technical Artist, Event Pipeline
offers.description: Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar. Join the VRChat team! We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves. We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms. You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises. What You'll Do Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed. Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability. Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable. Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists. Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness. Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar. Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026. Who You Are You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work). You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well. You can write scripts (most likely C# ) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk. You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality. You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them. You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow. You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.” Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!) Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity. Familiarity with the VRChat creator toolchain: Unity + VRChat SDK (Worlds/Avatars) + Creator Companion (VCC/VPM) Experience building interactivity in VRChat worlds using Udon / UdonSharp (C# that compiles to Udon) Familiarity with common VRChat avatar components like PhysBones/Contacts and performance best practices. Experience optimizing content for multiple hardware tiers and platforms (PC + mobile constraints, etc.). Experience supporting live ops or high-cadence content publishing. In addition, we won ‘Best Creative Service Provider’ at Develop 2022 and were nominated in 2023 & 2024. This Technical Artist opportunity will be a 12 month fixed term contract (with possible extension) based in either of our UK studio sites (Daresbury or Newcastle), on a hybrid working basis. Working pattern - 3 days per week in the studio: Wednesday, Thursday and another day of your choice. d3t’s art team blends technical excellence with a passion for the craft of game development. Our expertise spans the full development cycle—from co-development on features and content to benchmark creation and work on remakes / remasters. We deliver world-class content across Environment, Character, VFX, and Animation. We don’t just create art; we build the tools and pipelines that power it. We are expanding our studio and looking for a Technical Artist to help us redefine what’s possible. The Role - Technical Artist: What are we looking for? Responsible for helping to establish and maintain project art pipelines from inception and throughout the project life-cycle. Support the art and animation team requirements and assist with resolving technical issues. Assist with creating and integrating in-house toolsets and be involved in creating materials/shaders. Ensure all artwork hits memory and frame rate guidelines/restrictions by means of performance profiling. Collaborate with the artists and feedback on how they can improve the performance of the in-game assets while maintaining visual fidelity. Ensure all artwork adheres to guidelines regarding naming conventions, texture layering structures etc. Keep up to date with industry advancements and technologies and share knowledge with the art team. Add to our library of tutorials, documents and technical guides to improve efficiency in the art pipeline and be proactive in finding solutions to technical issues. Advise the Senior Technical Artist of resourcing concerns and production risks. Encourage and mentor other members of the Technical Art Team. Essential skills: Enjoy the technical challenge and constraints of real-time game art and have some understanding of modern rendering, shading and lighting techniques. Must be performance and quality focused. Must have an excellent working knowledge and proficiency in Maya and/or 3DS Max and an excellent in-depth knowledge in Python. Strong communication and organisation skills and confidence working within a multidisciplinary art team. Good understanding of the technical limitations of current console hardware. Practical and methodical approach to technical and creative problem-solving. Demonstrate dependability and commitment to projects and tasks, and a hunger to learn and improve as a Technical Artist. Flexible and calm approach with the ability to adapt to change. Ability to deliver quality work within fixed time constraints. Good knowledge of current game development practices and terminology and a passion for staying up to date with latest technology and embracing new game art techniques Desirable skills: Knowledge of other scripting languages is advantageous. Knowledge of the Maya API and programming in C++ or C# is advantageous Some understanding of various other tools and software used in development, Photoshop, Substance, Houdini etc is also advantageous. Knowledge of Unreal Engine or Unity is advantageous. Knowledge of materials/shaders and a good understanding of a PBR workflow. Experience of working within game development for at least 2 years. At least 1 published title. We work flexibly, but value in-person collaboration: this position is offered on a hybrid basis only at either of our UK sites (3 days per week in the studio: Wednesday, Thursday and another day of your choice). We value work/life balance and have a discretionary flexible hours system and operate a no-crunch policy as a studio. d3t Studio Benefits & Perks: 22 days holiday +3 Festive Studio Closure + Bank Holidays Company Pension Scheme Flexible Working Hours Private Medical Insurance Scheme - BUPA Anti-crunch ethos - a professional, fun and supportive working environment! Free Parking Company Socials, Monthly Lunches + Annual d3t Events Breakout Areas - filled with perks such as games, BBQ area, complimentary snacks to suit all dietary preferences etc. First interviews will be help by video call, followed by second interviews on-site. Don't meet every single requirement? Not a problem - please apply. At d3t we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and culture. If this opportunity excites you but your current skills or past experience don't align perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to still apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles within our team.

offers.description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Important Note: This team works onsite at EA Vancouver (Burnaby office). Applicants are required to work onsite 3 days, Tuesday - Thursday every week. EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment - connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. Building on an incredible 30-year foundation, we’re redefining football with EA SPORTS FC - a genre-leading ecosystem of interactive experiences, bringing a global community of football fans closer to The World's Game. Together, we’re taking the largest football club in the world to new heights - and this is just the beginning! With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC, and welcome everyone to the club! As part of our EA SPORTS™ FC studio, the Technical Art Team helps push visual boundaries and experiences for our players. We invest in future technologies, shared tooling, and production workflows. We combine creativity and imagination with technical expertise. We are a diverse group that encourages team members to bring their unique perspectives and expertise to work every day. Your Responsibilities The Technical Artist is a bridge between the artists and engineers. They are considered part of the art team and work closely with artists, project managers, SEs and the Technical Art team. The main areas of responsibilities include art production workflows, tools, pipelines, asset optimization/integration and shader development. TAs are expected to assume ownership over any technical issues that arise on their project and bring them to resolution. You can be from an Art, Design, Mathematics, Engineering or Computer Science background; however you must demonstrate a comfort level in working with both art and science. Technical Artists report to Technical Art Directors on the EA SPORTS team. This team works hybrid 3 days/onsite (Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursday) at EA Vancouver. Your Qualifications * Ideally at least 3 years of cinematic/games production experience. * A bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a related field is desired. * Effective at communicating with different audiences: artists, engineers, managers. * Extensive experience scripting/programming in python and C#. (C++ is a bonus, but is not required). * Knowledge of 3D art packages (Maya). * A solutions-provider, particularly as it pertains to testing and debugging technical issues. * A willingness to jump into the unknown and solve new problems; the ability to think creatively to resolve technical challenges and limitations. * A Passion for Games!                                                                                             For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win - together. You will work closely with artists, designers, and engineers to establish scalable procedural systems, improve production efficiency, and ensure generated content meets both visual quality and performance targets. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with practical production experience in procedural generation, world-building pipelines, optimization, and Unreal Engine 5 ecosystem technologies. Daily tasks: Design and implement scalable PCG frameworks in Unreal Engine 5. Develop production-ready procedural tools for Level Art and Environment Art teams. Build reusable procedural systems for biome population, vegetation placement, set dressing, road generation, and world composition. Define technical requirements and create implementation tasks for artists, designers, and engineers. Establish procedural generation standards and best practices. Collaborate with Level Artists to improve production workflows and iteration speed. Optimize procedural systems for World Partition-based projects. Analyze performance, memory usage, and streaming behavior of generated content. Document workflows, tools, and technical standards. QUALIFICATIONS Must have: Minimum 5 years of experience in game development or CG industry. Minimum 2 years of experience as a Technical Artist. Advanced knowledge of Unreal Engine 5. Strong production experience with UE5 Procedural Content Generation (PCG) Framework. Experience building artist-friendly procedural workflows and toolsets for Level Artists and Environment Artists. Deep understanding of World Partition, Data Layers, HLOD, Streaming, and open-world production workflows. Strong understanding of environment optimization techniques and performance profiling. Experience designing scalable content pipelines for large environments. Experience writing technical documentation and defining technical requirements for cross-functional teams. Ability to collaborate effectively with Art, Design, and Engineering departments. Strong understanding of Unreal Engine rendering and content pipelines. Wished: Experience with Houdini and Houdini Engine for Unreal (strong plus but not required). Experience with Geometry Script. Experience with Editor Utility Widgets and pipeline automation. Blueprint scripting experience. C++ knowledge for Unreal Engine workflows. Expertise in shaders, materials, and rendering optimization. Experience with Landscape, RVT, Foliage, Procedural Foliage, Splines, and World Building systems. Python scripting experience. Niagara and procedural VFX knowledge. Environment Art production experience. Knowledge of modular environment creation workflows and asset optimization. Soft skills: English level: B1+ Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Ability to gather production requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Strong ownership mindset. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor artists and promote procedural workflows across teams. Adaptability and willingness to iterate on solutions based on project needs. ABOUT US Founded in 2004, Virtuos is one of the largest independent video game development companies. We are headquartered in Singapore with offices in Asia, Europe, and North America. Specializing in full-cycle game development and art production, we have delivered high-quality content for more than 1,500 console, PC, and mobile games. Our clients include 23 of the top 25 gaming companies worldwide. About Our Team Established in 2023, Virtuos Labs - Warsaw is part of Virtuos' global network of studios dedicated to enhancing engineering and R&D capabilities to tackle complex AAA projects for our partners. The studio is home to industry-leading experts specializing in graphics rendering and optimization technology in video game production. WHAT WE OFFER • Work alongside industry veterans • Contribute to the world's biggest AAA games • Flexible working hours • Hybrid work culture People matter. Diverse opinions and experiences matter. At Virtuos, our talented teams are the cornerstone of our success, and we recognize that fostering and advocating for inclusivity is at the center of what we do best - we make games better, together. Virtuos is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that embraces diversity of thought, expression, culture, and backgrounds.

In this role, you will create 2D and 3D animations, develop real-time visual effects, and integrate your work into our Unity/Cocos2d-x-based projects. Working closely with artists, game designers, and developers, you will contribute to the visual identity of our games and enhance the overall player experience. We are looking for a team player who can take ownership of their work from concept to implementation and optimization, creating high-quality assets that align with the game's art direction and mobile performance requirements. What You'll Do Create 2D and 3D animations for characters, objects, and in-game elements. Set up 2D rigs in Spine, create animations, and integrate them into the game engine. Create character and object animations using Blender, Maya, or equivalent 3D software, and adapt existing animations when needed. Design stylized, real-time visual effects for in-game events, rewards, and transitions. Create UI animations that support game menus, progression systems, and player feedback. Integrate animations and visual effects into Unity/Cocos2d-x projects and collaborate with developers on any required technical adjustments. Ensure animations and effects enhance gameplay timing, clarity, and responsiveness. Optimize animations and effects for mobile devices while maintaining a balance between visual quality and performance. Create well-organized, reusable assets and contribute to improving production workflows. Take ownership of assigned tasks, track progress, and refine deliverables based on feedback. Strong hands-on experience with rigging, skinning, and 2D skeletal animation in Spine. Proficiency in Blender, Maya, or equivalent 3D software, particularly in animation and rigging workflows. Experience working with Unity or Cocos2d-x, including the integration of animations, particle systems, and visual effects into game engines. A solid understanding of fundamental animation principles, including timing, anticipation, weight, and follow-through. Understanding of mobile performance limitations and the ability to optimize assets accordingly. Ability to plan and deliver tasks in line with production timelines. Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to both give and receive constructive feedback. Good written and spoken English skills. Tools, Pipelines & Optimisation Create and maintain tools, scripts, and automated pipelines that improve animation productivity and asset quality. offers.description: PLAY, GROW and WIN To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator. At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004. Virtuosi is a team of experts - people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication. At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win - together. ABOUT THE POSITION Lead Technical Artist manages day-to-day work of all Technical Artists, providing clear guidance and instructions and promptly communicating important information to all team members. Work close with Art Directors and Producers to discover any possible ways to improve quality and efficiency of artists' work. Lead Technical Artist would be responsible for Technical Artists team's growth and development; identifies areas important for Art Department development; makes sure his/her team members are improving their skills or doing research in these areas; coaches his/her team members by demonstrating best approaches in solving technical issues related to art production. 技术美术组长负责技术美术师们日常的管理工作,提供明确的指导和指示,并及时向成员传达重要信息.同总监和制作人紧密合作来探索任何可能的方式以提升美术师制作的质量和效率. 技术美术组长对团队的成长和发展负责,鉴别对美术部门发展的重要领域并确保成员在此方面的技能有所提升或研究.通过向成员展示和美术作品相关的最佳解决方案来达到培养他们的目的. RESPONSIBILITIES Support, mentor and train Jr./Sr. Technical Artists. Support artist in their day-to-day task including troubleshooting, problem solving. Manage Technical Art requests from Multiple projects. Research and Development of tools, art pipelines. Writing documentation about art processes. Teach artist best practices for art creation. Work with programmers, artists and technical artists Work with different DCC apps like Maya, 3ds Max, Photoshop etc. Job tasks assigned by the manager. 支持,指导和训练初级/资深美术师 支持美术师的日常工作,包括检修和解决问题 管理来自多个项目的技术美术请求 研究和开发不同的美术工具,以及美术制作流程 编写有关美术过程的文档 教导美术师关于美术创意良好的实践经验 与程序员,美术师和技术美术师合作 使用不同的DCC应用程序,例如Maya,3ds Max,Photoshop等 完成由上级分配的任务 岗位要求: 有学习的能力,并具有对学习的兴趣和意愿 良好的书面和口头沟通能力 较强的解决问题和故障排除能力 较强的人际交往能力 要求会英语 QUALIFICATIONS Ability, interest and willingness to learn. Excellent communication skills both written and verbally. Strong problem solving and trouble-shooting skills. Strong interpersonal skills. English language skills are required. 有学习的能力,并具有对学习的兴趣和意愿 良好的书面和口头沟通能力 较强的解决问题和故障排除能力 较强的人际交往能力 可以使用英语作为工作语言 ABOUT US Founded in 2004, Virtuos is one of the largest independent video game development companies. We are headquartered in Singapore with offices in Asia, Europe, and North America. Specializing in full-cycle game development and art production, we have delivered high-quality content for more than 1,500 console, PC, and mobile games. Our clients include 23 of the top 25 gaming companies worldwide About Our Team Since the turn of the century, Xi'an has made a conscious effort to foster the growth of its high-tech industries, including software development firms. Virtuos has planted roots here as well, becoming a leading AAA game developer with an established studio in the city. As a result, Virtuos Xi'an has become the most attractive choice for anyone in Shaanxi province wishing to embark on a career in game development. And as the fastest growing studio in the whole of Virtuos, there's plenty of room for new talents to hop in and contribute to the world's biggest console games - a dream that would have been impossible even a decade ago. Since our establishment in 2012, Virtuos Xi'an has never stopped growing and continues to expand by providing top-quality art services from concept art to 3D art for major titles. WHAT WE OFFER • Work at Virtuos Xi'an, one of our fastest growing studios • Experience life in the historic capital of China • Contribute to the world's biggest AAA gaming titles • Customized training programs and regular workshops • Monthly gaming competitions and other activities • Gaming corners with consoles and a common area • Comprehensive medical healthcare provided for all staff • Relocation support provided • Career and international mobility opportunities with Virtuos Internal Mobility Program People matter. Diverse opinions and experiences matter. At Virtuos, our talented teams are the cornerstone of our success, and we recognize that fostering and advocating for inclusivity is at the center of what we do best - we make games better, together. Virtuos is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that embraces diversity of thought, expression, culture, and backgrounds.

Code/Script Review: Reviewing and approving the work of other TAs and senior artists to ensure code quality, efficiency, and adherence toestablishedtechnical standards. Performance Budget Ownership: Final authority and accountability for the game's art-related performance targets, ensuringart-relatedassets andrenderingsystems stay within hardware limits. offers.title: Senior Technical Artist
offers.description: Business Unit LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices. About the Hiring Team Lightspeed Studios Art Department brings together artists who focus on creative work across concept design, 3D modeling, animation, VFX, technical art, and cinematics. Driven by a shared love for games, the team explores how new and emerging technology can elevate our craft - building visually forward-looking IP and raising the bar on art quality across Lightspeed's games. What the Role Entails Spearhead and implement technical solutions for the art team, setting high standards and mentoring junior Technical Artists. Collaborate with different teams to facilitate the technical implementation and management of in-house and outsourced assets. Drive the development of state-of-the-art visuals that complement and enhance the game design. Prototype and author graphics features requiring high technical expertise. Develop novel content creation techniques and workflows to enhance efficiency and quality. Work closely with the Art, Engineering, and Production departments to meet all dependencies and requirements. Support the Art team in debugging tools and game-related issues. Optimize the game's run-time performance and memory consumption. Who We Look For Extensive knowledge of the content creation pipeline, including modeling, UV mapping, texturing, shading, lighting, FX, rigging, and animation. Demonstrable experience with modern game content creation workflows. Proven experience as a Technical Artist on shipped AAA titles. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently. Solid background in digital art (modeling, shading, lighting, VFX). Profound knowledge of Unreal Tech, including material creation and Blueprints. Strong proficiency in Linear Algebra and Calculus, essential for advanced 3D technology applications. Understanding of real-time physically based materials and rendering (PBR). Desirable Skills & Experience: Experience with the Substance suite and/or Houdini. Knowledge of lower-level programming languages such as C++. Understanding of shading languages, e.g. HLSL or GLSL. Extensive scripting experience for DCC applications, e.g. Python or C#. Location State(s) US-California-Irvine, US-California-Los Angeles The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $97,500.00 to $232,300.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis. Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company's 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee's tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year. Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

offers.title: Sr. VFX Artist
offers.location: Santa Monica, United States, United States
offers.description: This position is for temporary engagement through our staffing partner, Yoh Enterprise Solutions.Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for this position. This is a hybrid / onsite position. For nearly 40 years, Naughty Dog has been crafting best-selling, critically acclaimed games that constantly push the boundaries of narrative, gameplay, and technology. Naughty Dog recently released The Last of Us Part II Remastered as well as a current generation remake of The Last of Us Part I for the PS5. We're also proud to say that The Last of Us Part I and Part II are now available for the first time on PC. Currently, we're busy at the kennel working on Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, and we'd love to find talented individuals to join us! Naughty Dog games have long been lauded for their evocative, character-driven stories and attention to detail. We are committed to innovation within our games and as such have curated some of the top creative and technically innovative minds in the industry. We welcome diverse candidates and believe that a broad range of cultural and life experiences contribute to the overall well-being and success of the studio and the titles we craft together. Naughty Dog is seeking a Visual Effects Artist to come join our team! This talented individual should be able to work with minimal input and feel comfortable working in a team environment. Our ideal candidate has a background in VFX and a passion for video games. What you will do: Visualize, create and implement real-time visual effects Create effects that work optimally on the target platform Be proactive and self-motivated, seeking out tasks remaining to be done Collaborate with other effects artists, and the rest of the development team to make the best game possible Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed What skills you will use: Technical knowledge and artistic abilities working with sprite type particles and materials within a game engine or equivalent VFX experience on movies/tv/commercials that have aired Ability to optimize effects such that they run/render efficiently AND look great Strong sense of form, color, timing, and composition Advanced problem solving techniques and patience to resolve the numerous hurdles that present themselves while working to achieve the highest quality effects Natural tendency to take on a problem and to work with others until the problem is resolved Bonus Skills: Python scripting Houdini knowledge/experience #LI-AC At SIE, working with our partners, we consider several factors when setting each role's base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location. Please note that the individual base pay range may vary based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this role is eligible for benefit offerings that include medical, dental, and vision. Click here to learn more. The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below, this is an hourly rate. $69.09 - $86.35 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. offers.title: Technical Artist
offers.description: Description Keywords Studios is currently looking to expand its team in Southeast Asia. We're currently looking for an accomplished, enthusiastic, and self-motivated Technical Artist to join our team working on an exciting, new, and unannounced project. Keywords Studios is a global leader providing art services to AAA Publishers. Our work can be seen across many of the top-selling titles on console, PC and mobile. You'll get to work alongside seasoned developers bringing expertise from world-class AAA studios. These opportunities can be located in Malaysia, Indonesia, or Vietnam (Remote). Sponsorship and relocation are not being offered as part of this package. A Technical Artist at Keywords Studios: Creates and maintains tools, scripts and pipelines that help the art team produce high-quality visual content efficiently. Works closely with artists, designers, engineers and other technical experts to identify technical issues, improve workflows and support production needs. Helps the art team communicate technical requirements and constraints to the development team. Solves technical challenges creatively to maximise visual quality while staying within real-time performance and hardware limitations. Supports the creation, optimisation and implementation of complex visual content, including materials, shaders, procedural assets and VFX. Prototypes, develops, profiles and implements procedural VFX, including particles, post-processing effects, shaders and related visual systems. Contributes to pipeline development, optimisation and best practices across content creation, integration and performance. Drives the creation of complex procedural and physically based content, helping ensure assets are efficient, scalable and production-ready. Requirements Proven experience as a Technical Artist or similar role on a commercial game development project. Strong understanding of real-time art production, optimisation, pipeline development and technical problem-solving. Proficiency in scripting and other languages such as MAXScript, MEL, C#, Python, HLSL, GLSL. Good artistic eye, with the ability to balance visual quality, technical constraints and performance requirements. Experience with VFX, materials, shaders, lighting models, tool development, optimisation and pipeline development. Experience working with modern game engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity or proprietary engines. Experience with art production tools such as Photoshop, Houdini, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Maya or 3DS Max. Familiarity with source control workflows, ideally Perforce. Ability to work collaboratively across disciplines and iterate quickly based on feedback. Benefits Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process, please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry. PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice. Role Information: EN Studio: Keywords Studios Location: APAC, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam Area of Work: Art Service: Create Employment Type: Contract Working Pattern: Full Time, Remote/Hybrid
